meta.name: user-story-splitting
meta.description: Break a large story or epic into smaller deliverable stories using proven split patterns. Use when backlog items are too big for estimation, sequencing, or independent release.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型用户故事拆分为可交付的小故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到过大、难以估算和排期的需求条目
copy.tagline_en: Break large user stories into deliverable smaller ones
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often have backlog items too big for estimation and sequencing

howto.what: 当用户给出一个过大的用户故事或史诗时，Claude 会使用 8 种拆分模式（如工作流步骤、业务规则变体等）将其拆分为多个独立可交付的小故事，并输出每个拆分故事的完整格式（包含用户故事、验收条件等）。
howto.when: 当用户提供的故事或史诗太大，无法在一个冲刺内完成、无法估算或独立发布时触发。用户可以直接在对话中粘贴故事文本，或仅调用技能后由 Claude 询问。

say.text: 拆分这个史诗：作为管理员，我可以批量导入用户。
say.note: Claude 会应用拆分模式生成多个小故事。

say.text: 帮我拆分这个用户故事：作为用户，我想上传文件。
say.note: Claude 会按数据变体等模式拆分。

howto.what_en: When given a large user story or epic, Claude breaks it into smaller independently deliverable stories using 8 splitting patterns (e.g., workflow steps, business rule variations). It outputs each split story in full format including user story and acceptance criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a story or epic is too large for a single sprint, estimation, or independent release. User can paste the story text directly or invoke the skill and let Claude ask for it.

say_en.text: Split this epic: As an admin, I can bulk-import users.
say_en.note: Claude applies splitting patterns to generate multiple stories.

say_en.text: Help me split this user story: As a user, I want to upload files.
say_en.note: Claude splits by data variations or other patterns.
